ability.orimod.dash.description: Burst in the movement direction, or forward with no input. One air dash recharges on landing or a valid launch.
ability.orimod.bash.description: Launch from enemies, projectiles or spirit anchors. Hold the target key to aim and release to launch. Each target has a short reuse delay.
ability.orimod.glide.description: Hold jump while falling to slow descent and steer. Release jump, crouch, touch a wall or enter water to fold away.
ability.orimod.grapple.description: Use the target key on a green grapple flower to pull toward it. Crouch or press again to cancel. Obstructions and missing anchors interrupt the pull.
ability.orimod.stomp.description: Crouch and dash in the air with two blocks of clearance to dive. Landing damages nearby visible enemies without breaking blocks. An interrupted dive can still cause fall damage.
ability.orimod.bow.description: Hold use to charge, then release an energy arrow. Claim the first bow for free. Recraft with a bow, glow ink sac and amethyst shard.
shard.orimod.capacity.description: Adds 25 maximum energy and occupies one shard slot. Unequipping clamps current energy to the remaining capacity.
shard.orimod.recovery.description: After two seconds without spending, energy regenerates at 7.5 per second instead of 5. Occupies one shard slot.
shard.orimod.gathering.description: Attracts spirit light within four blocks. Other items are unaffected and solid collision remains. Occupies one shard slot.
shard.orimod.resilience.description: Four seconds after the last hit, spend 6 energy to recover 1 health. Triggers at most once every ten seconds. Occupies one shard slot.
shard.orimod.air_control.description: Air and glide steering respond 25% faster. This does not add jumps or dashes. Occupies one shard slot.
guide.orimod.blade: Claim a spirit blade after awakening. Use attack for a three-hit combo. Recraft with an iron sword, glow ink sac and amethyst shard.
guide.orimod.capacity: Permanently add 25 maximum energy, up to three times. Costs 30, 45 and 60 light. Capacity upgrades do not occupy shard slots.
guide.orimod.awakening.title: Awakening
guide.orimod.awakening: Craft and use a spirit core with four copper ingots, four glass and one iron ingot. %s opens this panel; %s changes form. The core need not stay in your inventory.
guide.orimod.movement.title: Movement
guide.orimod.movement: %s changes form. %s jumps, double jumps, and glides when held while falling. %s dashes; combine with %s in the air to stomp. Move into a wall to slide, jump away, or crouch to release.
guide.orimod.bash.title: Bash and grapple
guide.orimod.bash: Aim at a highlighted target and press %s. Hold on a Bash target to aim for up to 0.6 seconds, then release. Green flowers pull you directly. Damage, menus, form changes and invalid targets interrupt.
guide.orimod.light.title: Spirit light
guide.orimod.light: Collect spirit light from defeated hostile mobs, discovered shrines and completed challenges. It is separate from experience and survives death. Repeat challenges grant a small reward; first rewards are paid once.
guide.orimod.shards.title: Shard slots
guide.orimod.shards: Unlock and equip shards in the shard tab. Effects apply in spirit form. Awakening opens one slot, Bash a second and Grapple a third. Equip up to three different shards.
guide.orimod.weapons.title: Weapons
guide.orimod.weapons: Claim the first weapon in the abilities tab. A full inventory preserves the claim. Weapons follow normal item drops and can be recrafted; unlocked abilities and light are permanent.
combat.orimod.form_required: Transform into spirit form to use spirit weapons
combat.orimod.bow_locked: Unlock Spirit Bow in the growth panel first
tooltip.orimod.blade_cancel: Press attack after the strike to chain; movement cancels recovery
tooltip.orimod.bow_energy: 12 energy per arrow; no ammunition required
tooltip.orimod.bow_charge: Charge 0.25 s to shoot, 1 s for full power; switch item to cancel
